one_liner: Customer service and helpdesk platform with ticketing, chat, and CRM.
blocker: Credentials require a Zendesk account on a listed paid plan (Team/Professional/Enterprise; no free tier or trial documented in the material) plus admin access to register an OAuth client, and legacy API tokens/basic auth are deprecated in favor of OAuth.

evidence.claim: Zendesk supports OAuth2 with both authorization code and client credentials flows, with bearer tokens in the Authorization header.
evidence.quote: Zendesk supports two OAuth flows. Identify which OAuth flow matches your integration:

evidence.claim: Basic authentication and API tokens are deprecated; customers must migrate to OAuth access tokens.
evidence.quote: If you're an existing Zendesk customer and are currently using basic authentication or API tokens, you will have to migrate to OAuth access tokens for improved security

evidence.claim: Registering an OAuth client requires signing in as an admin of the Zendesk account.
evidence.quote: You must be signed in as an admin. When creating a client for creating an OAuth token with the API, you don't need to specify any Redirect URLs.

evidence.claim: The API surface is broad, spanning ticketing, help center, chat, voice, CRM, and more.
evidence.quote: You'll find APIs for ticketing, help center, live chat, voice, sales CRM as well as some features that span capabilities, such as omnichannel routing and custom data.

evidence.claim: Zendesk officially documents acting as an MCP server exposing tools to third-party AI agents.
evidence.quote: Zendesk can also act as an MCP server in other scenarios. In that role, Zendesk exposes tools or resources that third-party AI agents can use

notes: Official docs confirm both an MCP client (GA, available on Suite Growth+/Support Team+ plans, for connecting Zendesk to external MCP servers) and an MCP server role exposing Zendesk tools to third-party agents. Multi-customer apps must use a global OAuth client per Zendesk Developer Terms; internal integrations can use regular OAuth clients scoped to one instance. Rate limits are plan-based (Team 200 rpm, Professional 400, Enterprise 700, High Volume add-on 2500). GraphQL exists only for Sell CRM company search. A third-party open-source zendesk-mcp-server also exists on GitHub (fruggr), separate from the official offering.
